name: CRITICAL: chats reactiveness
description:
**Summary**

1. **Problem:** reloading an existing chat replaced `chat.messages` with brand-new arrays/objects on every server read, forcing full re-renders of the whole chat (composer, intellisense, modals) on each streamed chunk.
2. **Store fix (`src/store/chats.js`):** added `mergeValue`/`mergeMessage`/`mergeMessages`/`applyChatMessages` so reloads and message endpoints patch messages **in place**, preserving the identity of unchanged messages and metadata.
3. **`mergeChat` changed:** it now patches `messages` entry-by-entry instead of assigning the new array, keeping the chat object and its collection identities stable.
4. **UI fix (`src/components/chat/Chat.vue`):** the `messages` computed reuses its previous array when the items are identical (`filter()` always returned a new one), and `sameFiles` was generalised to `sameList`.
5. **Effect / caveat:** only the message whose field truly changed re-renders; note `ChatEntry`'s `watch: message()` no longer fires on content refreshes (it should watch `'message.doc_id'` if that reload is still needed).

messages.content:
CRITICAL: chats reactive
Reloading an existing chat to get new data cuases all vue elements showing the chat to rull re-render. when must avoid that behavior causing lot of performance issues. chat is a complex element we must be able to patch it.  
For example on every new piece of info in a message chatintellisense or modal are rerendered.
